StudySyncRecord.title: StudySyncRecord
StudySyncRecord.description: Synchronized user study progress, Hifz FSRS state, and earned certificates scoped per user.

title.description: Human-readable title of the progress item, surah, or certificate.

referenceKey.description: Canonical identifier such as surah:ayah, lessonId, or certificate verification code.

scoreOrCount.description: Numeric score percentage, streak, or repetition count.

notes.description: Optional study notes, FSRS JSON state summary, or scholarly error report details.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/study_records/{recordId}.description: User-scoped study records for lessons, FSRS Hifz reviews, certificates, bookmarks, and scholarly error reports.
